numinance.kinds.v1.EvalCase.jsonschema.s.description: EvalCase is one replay case: it names a recorded outcome by digest and states what the replay must show.

category.description: category is the adversarial situation the case stands for; absent for an ordinary case.
category.title: Eval Category

expect.description: expect is required: what the replayed outcome must show.

name.description: name is required: a token of 1 to 64 characters, lowercase letters, digits and ". _ -", starting with a letter or digit.

outcome.description: outcome is required: the digest of the replay outcome record the recording produces under the set and this case.

seeded.description: seeded names the defect planted in the case and the layer expected to catch it; it needs a category.

numinance.kinds.v1.EvalCase.jsonschema.s.title: Eval Case

numinance.kinds.v1.EvalExpectation.jsons.description: EvalExpectation is the closed facts a replay is compared on. It names no text.

acceptance.description: acceptance is required: the expected human acceptance.
acceptance.title: Eval Acceptance

merged.description: merged is required: whether the change is expected to merge.

severe.description: severe is required: whether the outcome is expected to be a severity event (unauthorized action, critical escape or evidence gap).

verification_failures.description: verification_failures lists the expected failures by layer, sorted by layer without duplicates; empty when none are expected.

numinance.kinds.v1.EvalExpectation.jsons.title: Eval Expectation

numinance.kinds.v1.EvalLayerCount.jsonsc.description: EvalLayerCount is the number of verification failures expected from one verifier layer.

count.description: count is required and at least 1.

layer.description: layer is required: a token of 1 to 64 characters naming the verifier layer.

numinance.kinds.v1.EvalLayerCount.jsonsc.title: Eval Layer Count

numinance.kinds.v1.EvalSeeded.jsonschema.description: EvalSeeded is a defect planted in a case, by token. The defect itself is not in the set: the case stands for a recorded run on a change that has it.

caught_by.description: caught_by is required: a token naming the verifier layer expected to catch the defect; it must be among the case's expected failures.

defect.description: defect is required: a token of 1 to 64 characters naming the planted defect.

numinance.kinds.v1.EvalSeeded.jsonschema.title: Eval Seeded

numinance.kinds.v1.EvalSet.jsonschema.st.description:
EvalSet is a versioned, reference-only set of replay cases (RFC-0004). A case names a recorded replay outcome by digest
 and states what that outcome must show; it holds no free text, ticket, code or person. An EvalSet is an alpha kind: its
 apiVersion is "numinance.dev/v1alpha1" and a loader reads it only when the caller turns alpha kinds on. It takes no part in
 profile resolution and is not an input to the profile digest.

apiVersion.description: api_version is required and is "numinance.dev/v1alpha1" (pre-GA; off unless the loader enables alpha kinds).

extensions.description: extensions holds vendor or customer data under reverse-DNS keys; the Engine never reads it.

metadata.description: metadata is required; the loader enforces it, the schema cannot.

spec.description: spec is required; the loader enforces it, the schema cannot.

numinance.kinds.v1.EvalSet.jsonschema.st.title: Eval Set

numinance.kinds.v1.EvalSetSpec.jsonschem.description: EvalSetSpec holds the version of the set and its cases.

cases.description: cases is required: 1 to 256 cases, sorted by name without duplicates; the loader enforces the count and the order.

version.description: version is required: a strict x.y.z version. Any change to a case is a new version, and a new version is a new bundle digest.

numinance.kinds.v1.EvalSetSpec.jsonschem.title: Eval Set Spec

numinance.kinds.v1.Metadata.jsonschema.s.description: Metadata names a kind object and fixes its scope.

name.description: name is required and unique per kind and scope; other kinds reference the object by it.

scope.description: scope is required and not SCOPE_UNSPECIFIED; the loader enforces the latter.
scope.title: Scope

numinance.kinds.v1.Metadata.jsonschema.s.title: Metadata

numinance.types.v1.Digest.jsonschema.str.description: Digest is a sha256 content digest as "sha256:" plus 64 lowercase hex characters.

value.description:
value is exactly "sha256:" plus 64 lowercase hex characters. Any other
 length, case or prefix, and an empty value in a present message, is
 rejected. Absence is the unset message.

numinance.types.v1.Digest.jsonschema.str.title: Digest
